jobs.description:
We are extra[not]ordinary

*(ex· tra· not· or· di· nary |\ ik-ˈstr-not-ȯr-də-ˌner-ē)

Adjective: A unique word for Genmab meaning to go way beyond what is

usual; to be remarkable; proudly unique and authentic

Back to search results

Previous job Next job

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Role

We are seeking an experienced SAP Manager, Sales and Distribution (SD), to lead and support SAP initiatives across Order-to-Cash (OTC) and logistics business processes. The ideal candidate will bring strong SAP S/4HANA experience, deep functional expertise in SAP SD and logistics, and an understanding of end-to-end OTC processes within the life sciences industry. The successful candidate will have participated in at least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation and be adept at translating business needs into scalable, sustainable solutions.

This role is responsible for solution design, implementation, process optimization, stakeholder management, and ongoing operational support. Working closely with Finance, Corporate Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, DD&AI, Business COE, affiliates, and external partners, the SAP Manager will drive SAP best practices and facilitate cross-functional decisions aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards, and Genmab’s SAP S/4HANA roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

SAP SD Solution & Delivery

• Lead SAP SD and logistics design, configuration, implementation, enhancement, and support across S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, and rollouts.

• Provide functional expertise across end-to-end OTC processes, including sales order management, pricing, availability checking, delivery, shipping and transportation, billing, returns, credit/debit processing, and credit management.

• Support customer and business partner master data, intercompany transactions, and third-party sales scenarios.

• Manage process integration between SAP SD, MM, FI/CO, EWM/WM, TM, and external systems.

• Translate business requirements into scalable solutions through fit-to-standard/fit-gap analysis, prioritizing standard S/4HANA capabilities and minimizing unnecessary customization.

• Advise on S/4HANA simplifications and process changes affecting SD and logistics.

• Coordinate functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Maintain documentation of requirements, functional designs, configurations, test scenarios, and operating procedures.

• Oversee production support, resolve complex issues, and drive root-cause analysis and permanent solutions for recurring problems.

• Ensure solutions comply with Genmab policies, internal controls, and audit expectations; support audits and timely remediation of findings

Business & Stakeholder Management

• Facilitate requirements workshops, identify process improvements, prioritize enhancements, and support solution decisions and adoption.

• Optimize order fulfillment, delivery, and shipping across internal operations and external logistics partners.

• Align billing, credit management, intercompany transactions, and financial integration with accounting processes and control requirements.

• Coordinate architecture and design reviews, interfaces, APIs, enhancements, reports, forms, and workflows, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and the SAP roadmap.

• Communicate SAP concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and manage expectations, priorities, dependencies, risks, and issues across initiatives.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an advanced degree is a plus.

• 8+ years of SAP SD and logistics experience, including 3+ years with SAP S/4HANA.

• Participation in at least one full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation, from requirements through stabilization; experience leading an SD or logistics workstream preferred.

• Strong hands-on expertise in SAP SD, end-to-end Order-to-Cash, and related logistics and supply chain processes.

• Experience integrating SAP SD with MM, FI/CO, EWM/WM, and TM; broader experience with EWM, TM, or GTS preferred.

• Experience with SAP configuration, functional specifications, testing, data migration, cutover, and production support.

• Working knowledge of SAP Fiori and S/4HANA capabilities; relevant SAP certification preferred.

• Experience integrating SAP with 3PLs, warehouse systems, transportation providers, or customer platforms, and familiarity with APIs, IDocs, EDI, and middleware preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with business and technology teams; experience managing implementation partners and managed service providers preferred.

• Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a complex enterprise environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause analysis skills, with a focus on sustainable solutions and continuous improvement.

• Life sciences experience and knowledge of commercialization and supply chain processes preferred, along with experience supporting global SAP deployments.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK563.040,00---844.560,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Design for the people in the tiny chairs

At Famly, we build software that takes admin off the plates of early-years educators, so they can spend their time where it matters - with the children. And we make it easier for over a million parents to stay close to their child's day, even while they're at work.

We're looking for a design system builder to join the design team - responsible for the design system, prototyping tools and all other infrastructure with the goal of driving consistency and coherence across the entire product.

About Famly

We’re on a mission to stop admin stealing the joy of working with young children. We do that with our platform, the world’s first proactive assistant for educators and staff that handles admin for them so they can get back to what they love. And we do it with our content (like The Tiny Chair Podcast), reminding educators of the joy and meaning that got them into working with children in the first place.

About the role

You live where design and code meet. With a small team, you'll own Famly's design system: the components, patterns, and documentation that product teams (and increasingly, AI agents) build on every day.

The team's job is coherence. Every feature and every domain should feel like it came from the same place. You'll give builders what they need to design and build to our standards, and keep the conversation going so the system keeps getting better.

You'll bring deep technical knowledge of design systems, and you'll care just as much about how the product feels to the people using it.

The team is based in our Copenhagen office, but we are open to you being based somewhere else.

What you'll be doing

• 
Build production-quality React and TypeScript components for Famly's design system.

• 
Design component APIs that are hard to misuse, and version them so upgrades don't break product teams.

• 
Write the documentation that makes those components self-serve, so a new engineer or an AI agent can pick one up and use it correctly without asking anyone.

• 
Keep the system trustworthy: tests, visual regression, and a release process people don't dread.

• 
Learn Famly's frontend deeply enough to know where a pattern lives, who depends on it, and what breaks if it changes.

• 
Audit and evolve the components we already have, for consistency, accessibility, and reuse across the product.

• 
Own the code side of the design standard with a small team, so design intent survives the trip into production.

• 
Push back when a design won't hold up in code - too many states, no empty case, a pattern that already exists - and say what you'd do instead.

• 
Work with PMs, designers, and engineers across product teams, and bring them ideas before they ask.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

• 
You have 5+ years of frontend experience in B2B SaaS, including design system work.

• 
You're strong in React, TypeScript, and CSS.

• 
You have taste for craft: spacing, motion, states, and the details that make a component feel finished.

• 
You think in systems: reusable, documented, maintainable components over one-off fixes.

• 
You get from a rough idea to a working prototype fast.

• 
You own your work end to end, from discovery through testing to shipping.

• 
You care about the difference between "works" and "is right," and you'll say so and set the direction.

The interview process looks like:

• 
Short meet and greet with Lead People Partner

• 
A logical test

• 
1st interview: Meet and greet with our Senior Director of Product Design

• 
Take-home assignment

• 
2nd interview: Assignment presentation with Senior Director of Product Design and Lead Designer

And who are Famly?

You’re probably wondering at this stage, and Famly are...? Well, it all began when our co-founder Henrik’s daughter was ready to start at daycare. He couldn’t believe the amount of work being done on paper - and how distant he felt from his first child during the day. The paper ‘parent’ books they exchanged once a month just weren’t cutting it. Together with his friend, our co-founder and CEO Anders, they set about solving that.

These days, about 180 of us build Famly for more than 10,000 institutions and over 1 million parents.

We handle admin stress so they can get back to what matters, and we make it easier than ever to connect home, and nursery so parents can play a part in their child’s day. If you join us, you’ll be building, selling, or support customers with everything from staff rotas and invoices, to child development and parent communication.

How we work

Famly prides itself on a few principles; we choose simplicity, we believe friendliness is a superpower, we set the pace, and we want everyone to be surrounded by talent.

It all adds up to a culture that refuses to make employees choose between a place that is ambitious and sets the pace for what good looks like - and one that is a nice place to work. We think you can be ambitious and kind and when you get to meet our team, we hope you’ll agree.

What we expect of you, is that you make others shine, that you believe in being better than yesterday, and you are not afraid to just ‘get it done’. Finally, we want you to value ‘sitting in the tiny chair’ - which means you look at your work through the impact it has on our customers: the people sitting in tiny chairs in childcare settings all over the world.

What’s in it for you?

• 
Competitive pension, private health insurance, and paid maternity/paternity leave.

• 
A clear career framework and coaching to make sure you’re growing, a $1000 personal development budget and a ‘We’ll buy you any book you want’ policy.

• 
We guarantee we’ll create the time, space and leadership (as well as the budget) to make sure you grow and develop.

• 
We want to set the pace, and don't cut corners when it comes to investing in tooling and technology that you need to be at the frontier of tech.

• 
We’re all about hiring clever people who are good humans too. It means Famly is full of top thinkers and generous teammates waiting to help you shine.

• 
We like to give a lot of ownership both in terms of responsibility and freedom to try new, challenging tasks.

• 
Top-notch work equipment (including noise cancelling headphones for those focus periods!).

• 
We believe collaboration happens best in person, so we have the default of four days a week in office - but with plenty of flexibility for when life happens outside the office too.

We're looking to fill the position as soon as possible, so get your application in today by sending us:

• 
Your CV

• 
Short and precise cover letter to tell us what you can bring to the role

• 
Portfolio (attached or linked) showcasing your work

Looking forward to hearing from you!

The inside scoop on Famly

Wanna get to know Famly even better? Then have a look at our website to learn more about:

• 
our product and our mission

• 
our company and who we are

• 
our company values

• 
what it's like working at Famly

Want to get know more about how we work in Famly?

One of our builders, Matthew Fitzsimmons talking about how he, and the other builders are working with AI.

Our CEO, Anders Laustsen talking about embracing AI

Famly is committed to creating a more diverse, equal, and inclusive workforce, building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences. It is a fundamental policy at Famly not to discriminate on any basis or characteristics and celebrate diversity. Everyone is welcome and encouraged to apply.

jobs.occupation: Are you our new jewellery design intern?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a jewellery design intern to support us with design and production.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an intern jewellery designer. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within jewellery design, fashion design or something similar, the ideal candidate should have:

• Experience in Rhino software

• Knowledge of rendering in Keyshot is an advantage.

• Skilled in ideation and sketching.

• Responsibility to meet deadlines and take ownership of the project.

• Ability to work independently in a high-paced start-up environment.

• Willingness to be a part of something new and exciting.

**

What you will do:**

As an intern, you will help develop new jewellery styles and collections by sketching new designs, and drawing up designs in Rhino. You will also have the opportunity to work with our partners for translating the designs into the hands of our craftsmen, as well as preparing the right quality image material for frontline sales and marketing use.

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building a new jewellery brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.

Do you want to helps us transform the way passengers and baggage move through airports? Do you want to play a key role in developing the high-level control software that powers the next generation automated screening solutions?
Then join us as our new Senior Software Engineer

Join BEUMER Group and Shape the Future of Airport Security
The global aviation industry is facing increasing demands for security, operational efficiency, and passenger experience. SECTRO is BEUMER Group’s strategic response to these challenges, combining advanced automation, intelligent system integration, and scalable software solutions to create the future of airport security screening. As SECTRO continues its transition from development into industrialization and execution, software has become a critical success factor in delivering a standardized, configurable, and globally scalable product portfolio.

Your Role
As our Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical authority and go-to person for High-Level Control (HLC) within SECTRO. You will be responsible for maintaining an overall overview of the HLC tools, ensuring alignment across projects and products, and driving the evolution of our software platform. The role combines technical leadership, stakeholder management, roadmap development, and hands-on execution. You will be part of a global and cross-functional engineering setup, collaborating closely with software, automation, and system engineers, as well as external partners and suppliers.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Act as the technical focal point and subject matter expert for HLC solutions across the SECTRO product portfolio.

• 
Maintain the overall overview of the HLC landscape, ensuring consistency, standardization, and scalability across projects.

• 
Drive technical decision-making and architectural direction for HLC software solutions for SECTRO.

• 
Contribute to defining and maintaining the SECTRO roadmap.

• 
Translate business needs, project requirements, and technology opportunities into actionable development initiatives.

• 
Lead the design, development, and implementation of High-Level Control software solutions.

• 
Collaborate with external suppliers and technology partners to ensure seamless integration.

• 
Support project teams with expert guidance throughout design, implementation, commissioning, and operational phases.

Technology Stack

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will get the chance to work with the following Tech-stack:

• 
Microservice-based architecture

• 
C# 14+

• 
.NET 10 and ASP.NET Core

• 
REST APIs and service-oriented integrations

• 
Docker and Kubernetes

• 
CI/CD using GitLab and Helm Charts

• 
Git and GitLab source control management

• 
Distributed systems and cloud-native design principles

• 
SQL-based data management and configuration handling

• 
Integration with industrial automation platforms and High-Level Control systems

What You Bring

We imagine you a degree withing Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or related technical field and have extensive experience within complex industrial, logistics, automation, or mission-critical environments.

Moreover we expect you to have:

• 
Knowledge of software architecture, system integration, and interface design.

• 
Experience with High-Level Control systems, distributed software platforms, or similar solutions.

• 
Proven ability to drive technical direction and coordinate activities across global and multidisciplinary teams.

• 
Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.

• 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• 
A proactive mindset with a high degree of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

You are fluent both in both written and spoken English.

Interested?
If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact TPO & Team Manager, SECTRO Christian Kjer Elkjær at +45 3176 7183 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Vestergaard Holm at +45 3176 0448.

BEUMER Group
Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a work culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

• 
During our immersive onboarding program in, you will receive an extensive overview of BEUMER Group, our history, and our vision for the future, whilst also getting to know your new colleagues.

• 
Through a culture of open feedback, transparent corporate updates, and regular employee events, we actively cultivate a friendly, open, and collaborative working environment

• 
Your personal and professional growth is integral to our ethos. We champion your development through a wide range of training courses and upskilling opportunities — including support for external courses and grants for trainees.

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

• 
Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

• 
You will get access to Denmark’s largest discount portal, and receive exclusive discounts and promotional offers from a wide-range of companies and businesses.

• 
From accident insurance to attractive company pension schemes and health insurance for you and your children, we are committed to supporting your long-term well-being.

• 
Supporting you when you are not in work is also important to us. Our Staff Association organizes and sponsors social, cultural, and sporting activities, including our annual Christmas and Summer parties, which are always great fun.

• 
Sustainability is one of our key core values, which we tackle on multiple fronts. For example, you will have access to our electric charging stations in the employee parking area, with the electricity being provided at cost price.

• 
Fair pay is extended to all our employees, and we ensure we provide a balanced and equitable remuneration framework. You will also receive a number of additional salary benefits that combine to form an attractive salary package.

• 
Everyone needs a rest and a break from work at some point. That is why you will receive 30 days of vacation days per year, as well as various other special holiday days. We also provide extra support for maternity and paternity leave.

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer | North Aquaculture · Grindsted, Denmark
jobs.description:
We aim to strengthen our Engineering Department and are therefore seeking a Project Engineer. You will receive training in RAS (Recirculating Aquaculture System) design and engineering, including pressure loss calculations, pipe system dimensioning, quality control of mechanical equipment such as pumps and heaters/chillers, sizing of water treatment facilities, creation and coordination of drawings, P&ID’s, and other technical project documents.

As a Project Engineer, we are looking for a systematic, detail-oriented, and self-motivated individual who enjoys working on problem-solving. You will receive training and guidance, but we expect you to take initiative and take ownership of your daily tasks.

Main responsibilities:

• Create and maintain design & engineering deliverables throughout the project life cycle.

• Coordinate and evaluate technical documentation and system descriptions.

• Collaborate with our design, project and sales team

• Consult with customer, project group and subcontractors.

• Dimensioning and calculation of water treatment system, piping systems and RAS-equipment.

• The role will involve some traveling to our clients and RAS facilities.

Qualifications and experience:

• Ideally, a Bachelor’s degree or Technical education in mechanical, hydraulic or process engineering.

• Preferably 1-3 years of relevant work experience.

• You thrive working as part of a team but can also work independently.

• You are analytical and have problem-solving skills

• Fluent in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Experience from the landbased aquaculture industry is an advantage.

Are you curious about how world-class software products are built and delivered?

At Trackman, we create innovative technology used by athletes and sports enthusiasts around the world. Behind every great product is a strong focus on quality, and we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Software Quality Assurance team and help us ensure that our web applications deliver the best possible user experience.

This is a great opportunity for a student who enjoys technology, has an eye for detail, and wants practical experience working closely with software developers, product teams, and QA professionals in a modern technology company.

The Role

As a Student Assistant in Software Quality Assurance, you will become part of a collaborative team working with the quality of our web-based products and services.

You do not need prior experience in software testing. We are primarily looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and motivated to understand how software products are developed and improved.

Your responsibilities may include:

• 
Helping validate new features and improvements across our web applications

• 
Exploring the software from a user perspective and identifying areas that can be improved

• 
Assisting with documenting findings and communicating observations to developers and product teams

• 
Supporting the maintenance of test documentation and quality-related processes

• 
Participating in team meetings and collaborating with colleagues across development and product teams

• 
Contributing to quality initiatives that help us continuously improve our products

You will gain hands-on experience with software development processes, quality assurance practices, defect reporting, and modern collaboration tools used in professional product development environments.

Job requirements

Who We Are Looking For

We imagine that you:

• 
Are currently enrolled in a higher education program

• 
Have an interest in software, technology, or digital products

• 
Enjoy learning new systems and tools

• 
Are structured and pay attention to details

• 
Like collaborating with others and communicating your observations clearly

• 
Take responsibility for your tasks and are comfortable working independently when needed

• 
Have good English communication skills, both written and spoken

Most importantly, you are curious, motivated to learn, and enjoy understanding how things work.

It Is a Plus If You Have Experience With

Don't worry if you don't tick all the boxes. These are simply nice-to-have skills that you can also learn while working with us:

• 
Basic understanding of websites, web applications, or software development

• 
Experience working with technical tools or systems

• 
Interest in software testing, quality assurance, or product quality

• 
Familiarity with Azure DevOps or similar collaboration tools

What We Offer

At Trackman, you will join a team of passionate colleagues who are eager to share their knowledge and help you grow professionally.

We offer:

• 
Practical experience within software quality assurance and product development

• 
Mentorship and support from experienced QA professionals

• 
Insight into how innovative software products are developed and maintained

• 
A flexible student position that works alongside your studies

• 
A modern workplace with excellent facilities at our headquarters in Hørsholm

• 
Great colleagues, social activities, and plenty of opportunities to learn and develop

The position is expected to be 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility around exams and study commitments. The role is primarily based at our office in Hørsholm.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.

jobs.occupation: Are you our new digital marketing & content creation intern?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a digital marketing & content creation intern to help us with marketing and branding.

longvé is a dynamic and innovative jewellery start-up located in the heart of Copenhagen, near Kongens Nytorv. We offer a fresh digital approach to the jewellery industry, with our digital platform empowering customers to design their own jewellery. We offer the customers classic customisable designs, handcrafted quality and sustainable sourcing of recycled materials, all at a transparent and fair price. The company launched at the end of 2022.

We are currently seeking an digital marketing/content creator intern. This is a unique opportunity to impact a newly launched brand, and get a steep learning curve, while working in a high-paced start-up environment, where we make sure to have fun.

Besides being enrolled in a study program within marketing, social media, content production, creative or multimedia design, the ideal candidate should have:

• Ambitions within digital marketing and content production

• A sublime eye for detail and aesthetics

• Experience with using the Adobe suite (experience within other platforms such as Lightroom is also a benefit)

• A passion for editing work and acknowledge that the details are super important

• A team player mindset and appreciate getting constructive feedback

• Excellent writing skills in both Danish and English (fluent in English)

• The ability to be self-leading and take ownership of own tasks

What you will do:

• Produce content (videos and photos) for organic use across social media

• Be part of planning the campaigns and come up with creative ideas for content

• Create graphic material for social content, social ads and other digital channels

• Editing photos and videos from photoshoots

• Support in planning and coordinating photoshoots

• Assist with social media management and execution

• Assist with setting up content for email campaigns and programs

• Ad-hoc marketing tasks

What you get:

• Hands-on experience with building and activating a new digital brand

• Insights into and experience with the start-up world

• Possibility to build up portfolio material

• Autonomous working schedule where you can influence ways of working

• Working closely with the founders and joining a team that values great energy, good humour and strong collaboration

The start date and length of the internship will be agreed with the selected candidate. The internship may lead to a potential job opportunity based on the fit, skills, and growth of the business.

We promise to give you hands-on experience as well as an exciting playground for you to test, develop and execute great ideas. If you find this an exciting opportunity, please send your CV and resume, with some examples you have done, and the style you like personally. Send to Katja Schjølin at katja@longve.com.

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Manager - Data & Migration Team
jobs.description:
As our next Technical Project Manager in the Data & Migrations team, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most

About the role

This is a Senior role designed to provide program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. As a manager within the Migration team, you will be handling projects and programs with regards to migration implementation to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth and regulatory compliance. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

You will provide program/project management oversight for all customer implementations falling under the Migrations team’s scope.

You will lead project teams consisting of data engineers/scientists. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, project management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

As a Technical Project Manager for the Migration team your responsibilities include:

• Monitoring program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Providing executive level summaries for senior executives in BASE life science.

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Developed plans and effort estimates for future project during sales process.

Delivering Projects:

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver data driven projects on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their data needs and translate them into technical specifications for the project team.

• Develop project plans, timelines, and budgets for the projects.

• Track and report on project progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

What makes you the best person for this job?

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project manager ideally within the life science industry or other regulated areas.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading developers, data engineers and/or data scientists and delivering data driven projects.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

• A genuine interest in understanding the technical aspects of complex data-driven projects.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following qualifications:

• Experience with coding in Python, VBA, Java, R, SQL, C, or similar.

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault.

This position is offered in Copenhagen, Denmark and Barcelona, Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.occupation: Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management DK/ES
jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

At Körber Supply Chain DK, we design and deliver advanced automated material handling solutions to customers worldwide. As demand continues to grow and our project portfolio expands, we are looking for an experienced Lead Mechanical Engineer to strengthen our Mechanical Engineering team in Arden.

This is a key technical leadership role where you will take ownership of the mechanical engineering discipline across complex automation projects. You will play a central role in ensuring high-quality engineering solutions while driving collaboration across projects, teams, and stakeholders.

Your role:

As Lead Mechanical Engineer, you will be responsible for leading and coordinating all mechanical engineering activities throughout the project lifecycle, from concept development and design through manufacturing, installation, and commissioning.

You will act as the technical lead within the mechanical discipline, ensuring that solutions meet customer requirements, comply with relevant standards, and are delivered on time and with the expected level of quality.

Working closely with Project Managers, Electrical and Software Engineers, customers, suppliers, and external partners, you will help turn complex requirements into practical and reliable automation solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

•    Leading and coordinating mechanical engineering activities across projects

•    Developing and reviewing mechanical concepts, layouts, and detailed designs•    Ensuring compliance with machinery directives, safety standards, and internal engineering guidelines

•    Managing and supporting internal engineers and external engineering resources

•    Conducting design reviews, technical evaluations, and risk assessments

•    Providing technical leadership and mentoring within the Mechanical Engineering team

•    Supporting procurement activities through technical specifications and supplier evaluations

•    Ensuring timely delivery of engineering documentation, including drawings, BOMs, calculations, and technical reports

•    Supporting manufacturing, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities when required

Your profile:

You are an experienced mechanical engineer who combines strong technical expertise with natural leadership skills. You enjoy taking ownership, setting direction, and supporting colleagues while remaining hands-on when needed. Proven ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously across different stages, from design and procurement through manufacturing and installation. You maintain a forward-looking overview of priorities, dependencies and resource requirements, ensuring a balanced workload and early communication of potential capacity constraints or deadline impacts.

You are comfortable working in a project-driven environment where priorities may change and where collaboration across disciplines and cultures is key to success.

We imagine that you have:

You hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Technology, or a related technical discipline and bring 7-10 years of experience within mechanical design and development of customer-specific machinery or automation solutions. You have a proven track record as a Lead Engineer or technical lead on complex engineering projects and possess strong experience with 3D CAD systems such as Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks, or similar tools.

In addition, you have a solid understanding of mechanical design principles, manufacturing processes, material selection, and tolerancing, combined with experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional project collaboration. Knowledge of machine safety, CE marking, risk assessments, and relevant industry standards is expected. Finally, you are a strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English skills. Experience within material handling, intralogistics, automation systems, ERP/PLM systems, or delivery of machinery to the North American market will be considered an advantage.

Why Should You Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

We offer an exciting role in an international company in growth, where you will work with advanced technical solutions and be part of a strong professional environment characterized by collaboration and dedication. We offer a range of attractive employee benefits:

Security & Health: In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our mandatory pension scheme, which also includes both health insurance and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen provides healthy and exciting meals every day.

Development: We continuously offer training and courses, as we believe that our success is built on satisfied and skilled employees. That’s why we focus on both personal and professional development to ensure continuous growth.

Social Events: We have a strong company culture that we invest heavily in maintaining and developing. This includes a wide range of events and an active employee association that organizes activities such as Friday bars, Christmas parties, an annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more!

For our client, world leader within sonar technology – Teledyne RESON A/S, we are looking for a Toolmaker, Machinist, or other background as a skilled operator of machine tools.

Company Profile:

Teledyne Marine is a world leader in supplying high-quality underwater acoustic solutions, underwater autonomous vehicles, navigation systems and software with global presence and service facilities around the world. In Teledyne Marine, Europe we are specialized in design, development, manufacturing, marketing and commissioning of advanced Multibeam sonar systems, Inertial Navigation Systems with Fiber Optic Gyro’s and sensor software for real-time data collection and processing. We operate in the hydrographic, offshore, dredging, defense & security and marine research business areas.

Job Summary:

As Teledyne RESON’s new Toolmaker, you will be part of the Technology and Products department. The group cooperates in defining, developing, testing, prepare production setup and handover of new products to Operations for numerous product lines.

Our products consist of real-time Single- and Multi-beam Sonar Systems, Inertial Navigation System and related products. Key parts are advanced sensors (Acoustical, Fiber Optic Gyro), low noise analog electronics, high power transmit stages and high performance signal processing platforms. The product lines span from small low power products for autonomous vehicle drones (ASV/AUV) to high-end deepwater sonar systems for large research vessels.

You will be working in the mechanical team with focus be on transducer prototyping, manufacturing processes, automation, and production support for new and existing products. You will be working with our current R&D workshop wizard who is retiring within 1 – 2 years. You will eventually be responsible for our R&D workshop. You will be part of development projects with design for manufacturability reviews, production tooling, procurement and set to work of production machines, prototyping build and documentation.

Key responsibilities:

• Prototype assembly of small- and full-scale acoustic sensors working close with the transducer designer

• Design and production of jigs, fixtures, dies, molds, machine- and cutting tools for prototype manufacturing.

• Material knowledge with metal, glue, plastic and urethane materials

• Build knowledge on glueing, priming and potting methods of various materials and metals

• Design for Manufacturing review (DFM)

• Support and maintenance of production equipment.

• Support to the daily operational tasks incl. troubleshooting and NCR/MRB-handling

• Corrective And Preventive Action (CAPA)

• Production documentation support to assembly- and test procedures

Job Requirements:

• Experience with setup and operation of lathes, milling machines, grinding machines, and jig grinders

• Experience with glueing, molding, potting of various materials is preferred

• Experience with CAD software is preferred.

• You are structured, systematic and quality-minded

• Drive and ability to complete task to agreed deadline

• Enjoy working both independently and in teams

• Proactive, positive and supporting personality

Educational level:

You have an education as a Toolmaker, Machinist, or other background as a skilled operator of machine tools.

Language skills:

Fluent in English to a professional level

Other relevant Information:

• Job position is in Slangerup, Denmark

**

Experience with Scope 3 emissions management

Background in industrial / manufacturing environments

Ready to Make a Difference?

If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

Our Commitment to Transparency

Danfoss engineers solutions that increase machine productivity, reduce emissions, lower energy consumption, and enable electrification.

The Aarhus Institute of Advanced Studies (AIAS) is pleased to announce an exclusive fellowship opportunity for a researcher who holds a position at a Swedish research institution. The fellowship is made possible through a collaboration with Riksbankens Jubileumsfond in Sweden.The purpose of the AIAS-RJ fellowship is to strengthen the ties and expand collaborations between the Swedish and Danish research communities.

Why apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

AIAS is a haven for intellectual exploration, hosting excellent researchers eager to develop their work in an interdisciplinary, international and collaborative environment. AIAS nurtures an innovative atmosphere where breakthroughs emerge through transparent, inclusive and reflective discussions, offering a space for engagement and creativity.

The AIAS-RJ fellowship gives the selected fellow the opportunity to concentrate on their own research interests while also being an active member of the AIAS research community and participating in and contributing to seminars and activities beyond their own field of expertise. The fellow must be eager to engage in the interdisciplinary community at AIAS and expand research collaborations with colleagues at Aarhus University.

Who can apply for an AIAS-RJ Fellowship

The call is open to curiosity-driven researchers who:

• are of any nationality who hold a tenured position at a Swedish research institution

• work within the humanities and social sciences

• have a research experience of minimum 4 years after completion of the PhD

A unique interdisciplinary platform at AIAS

AIAS fosters connections, sparks ideas and dissolves boundaries as fellows engage with researchers from different disciplines within the Institute and across departments and research hubs at Aarhus University. Therefore, the call welcomes applications from all research areas and themes.

With a location within the unique campus of Aarhus University, AIAS functions as an interdisciplinary platform that connects researchers across Aarhus University and international scholars. AIAS has fellows who work in thematic groups or in individual fellowships, and hosts events and activities, which AIAS-RJ fellows are welcome to join and contribute to.

AIAS and Aarhus University strive to create a multidisciplinary, inclusive academic environment and to be an inspiring workplace for all by fostering a culture in which the individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The fellowship includes

The AIAS-RJ Fellow is offered:

• a salary based on seniority (employment conditions and wages are regulated through the Danish collective union agreements)

• travel costs to and from Aarhus

• relocation assistance

• a moderate budget for research-related costs

The AIAS-RJ Fellow will have office space at AIAS and can participate in academic training activities, conferences and workshops at AIAS. They will also be affiliated with the relevant research environments at Aarhus University.

How to apply: Application process and deadline

Applications must be submitted online via the system: GrantOne.

In the ‘Guide for Applicants,’ you can find the detailed application requirements and more information on the structure of the application system, the selection criteria and the selection process.

Timeline of the application process

• Opening of call: August 2026.

• Deadline for applications: 24 November 2026 at 12.00 (noon) CET.

• Evaluation and selection period: December 2026 - March 2027.

• Applicants will receive answers: Ultimo March 2027.

• Fellowship begins: 1 September 2027.

About AIAS

As an 'Institute for Advanced Study,' AIAS brings researchers together across disciplines, seniority and nationality. AIAS offers fellowships for excellent researchers from all academic disciplines to pursue cutting-edge research projects for the benefit of society and humankind in optimal research conditions.

The daily encounter with colleagues from diverse research disciplines at AIAS provides fellows with fresh and different insights, methods and perspectives on their own research, leading to new and unexpected research questions and ideas.

Are you keen to support an organization that's on an exciting data journey? Then come join TDC Brands.

As the Data Governance Specialist, you will be a member of the Data Office, responsible for supporting and developing data governance initiatives across the organization. In this role you will work flexibly between the Data Office and embedded in business units to make data roles work day-to-day: enabling data consumers, assisting Data Domain Owners and Data Stewards.

You will have an important role in supporting data governance by working collaboratively with the business.

Key Responsibilities:

Enable Data Consumers:

• Support adoption of the strategic data platform and the Enterprise Business Glossary (EBG) among data consumers in your business domain, including AI and agentic consumers.

• Help consumers find, understand, and trust governed data so it actually gets used for business insights and automation.

Assist Data Domain Owners:

• Support your Data Domain Owner(s) in maturing the data domain map and semantic models.

• Align with Tech, DPO and Legal as needed when data domain priorities, critical data elements, or AI classifications are being set.

• Flag gaps early — missing owners, unclear sources, unresolved dependencies — so each wave starts on solid ground.

Assist Data Stewards:

• Provide on-demand support to Data Stewards as they assess and authorize changes and stay accountable for data quality at source.

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication:

• Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Data Domain Owners, Data Stewards, Glossary Term Owners and data consumers.

• Escalate issues that need central Data Office, Tech, DPO or Legal involvement.

Bonus

Experience with telecoms, familiarity with data cataloging tools, or an interest in how governed data enables AI and agentic use cases.

Qualifications

As a Data Governance Specialist, we expect you to have sufficient years' experience in data management and data governance. You most likely come from an industry that prioritizes critical and valuable data assets and applies 'just enough' data governance.

Key expectations of the role are having great communication skills, comfort in operating pragmatically ahead of a fully defined policy landscape, and an ability to interact with people across the organization to produce tangible benefits to our data and AI initiatives.

Are you driven by designing robust software architecture and solving complex system-level challenges in high-performance, real-time environments? Do you want to build systems that turn raw sensor data into precise and real-time metrics that golfers and broadcasters rely on?

At Trackman, we combine radar technology, computer vision, and data intelligence to redefine how golf is played, practiced and experienced. From local golf clubs to live TV broadcasts, our products set the global standard for accuracy, performance, and innovation.

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to play a central role in architecting and evolving the software systems behind Trackman Range and Golf Broadcast.

In this role, you will design and own key parts of our real-time data processing platform, ensuring it is scalable, maintainable, and performant under demanding conditions. You will work at the intersection of software engineering and applied algorithms, translating mathematical models and signal-processing concepts into robust, production-grade systems.

You will be responsible for system-level design decisions, improving software architecture, and driving engineering quality across the codebase. This includes diagnosing complex system behavior, addressing performance regressions, and ensuring high standards of reliability, testability, and maintainability.

The Ideal Candidate Has

• 
A master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field

• 
Strong expertise in C++ and Python, with a track record of building high-performance, production-grade systems

• 
Experience designing and owning scalable software architectures and real-time data processing pipelines

• 
Strong understanding of performance engineering, multi-threading, and system-level debugging (e.g., concurrency issues, performance regressions)

• 
Experience driving code quality, testing, CI/CD, and managing technical debt in production systems

• 
Experience with Linux-based systems for development, deployment, and debugging of distributed applications

• 
Experience with Docker for containerization and orchestration of those applications

• 
5+ years of relevant experience with ownership of critical systems or components

Other Valued Experience

• 
Radar technology, signal processing, numerical algorithms and sensor fusion

• 
Computer vision, tracking, and camera calibration

• 
Deep learning model implementation and optimization

• 
Real-time camera and video systems, including stream handling, data capture and encoding/decoding

• 
GPU acceleration and performance profiling
